stem: A surgeon suspects a midline dermoid cyst in the suprasternal notch; what is the most important reason to investigate this lesion carefully before surgery?

options.text: It usually resolves with expectant management
It typically originates from the parotid gland
It is usually caused by a recent viral infection

explanation: Intracranial communication is the key concern for a midline dermoid cyst. This possibility means the lesion needs careful assessment before surgical excision to avoid missing deeper extension.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because metastatic neuroblastoma is not the usual explanation for a midline dermoid cyst.
optionExplanations.B: Correct because a midline dermoid cyst may communicate intracranially, which is the main pre-operative concern.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because dermoid cysts do not typically resolve with expectant management.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because the parotid gland is not the typical origin of a suprasternal midline dermoid cyst.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because a recent viral infection suggests reactive lymphadenopathy rather than a dermoid cyst.
